intro: Offered by Harb Clawhoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, this exchange allows seasoned riders to trade their aging Green Kodo for a fresh mount from the newer herd. It provides tauren and Horde champions an opportunity to ride a great brown, gray or white kodo across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you bring me your aging kodo, I will trade it in for one from the new herd. The new kodo will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the great kodos we already have around the yard here to see what you will have to choose from.
